sloka: उपवासः च कर्तव्या यथा प्राणेन मैथिलि ।जटा भारः च कर्तव्यो वल्कल अम्बर धारिणा ॥२-२८-१३॥
transliteration: upavāsaḥ ca kartavyā yathā prāṇena maithili ।jaṭā bhāraḥ ca kartavyo valkala ambara dhāriṇā ॥2-28-13॥

translations.english: One has to wear robes of bark and matted hair and take to fasting as long as one can, O daughter of Mithila
